items.docs:
Creates a new recast or accept rule.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_RECAST.VM_RECAST.CREATE` for Vulnerability Management or `WAS.RECAST_RULE.MANAGE` for Web App Scanning. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Searches for rules that match the requested criteria.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_RECAST.VM_RECAST.READ` for Vulnerability Management or `WAS.RECAST_RULE.READ` for Web App Scanning. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: rule_id
params.description: The UUID of the recast rule to return details for.

items.docs:
Returns the details of the specified recast or accept rule.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_RECAST.VM_RECAST.READ` for Vulnerability Management or `WAS.RECAST_RULE.READ` for Web App Scanning. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: rule_id
params.description: The UUID of the recast rule.

items.docs:
Updates the specified recast or accept rule with the specified criteria.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_RECAST.VM_RECAST.EDIT` for Vulnerability Management or `WAS.RECAST_RULE.MANAGE` for Web App Scanning. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: rule_id
params.description: The UUID of the recast rule to delete.

Deletes the specified recast or accept rule.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_RECAST.VM_RECAST.DELETE` for Vulnerability Management or `WAS.RECAST_RULE.MANAGE` for Web App Scanning. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Returns the list of properties that can be used to filter recast rules, including each property's supported logical operators and value types.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_RECAST.VM_RECAST.READ` for Vulnerability Management or `WAS.RECAST_RULE.READ` for Web App Scanning. See [Roles](doc:roles).
